scope: regional categorical history availability and compatibility presentation
acceptanceAssertions: An explicitly selected unknown observation does not fall back to an older positive or negative observation.
A record without a regional result is not evaluated and is not treated as normal.
A malformed source-bound map is record-unavailable and does not produce a trend.
An absent requested record is record-unavailable and does not fall back to the newest record.
A changed method, normalization, model hash or validation evidence starts a separate series.
Only two or more observations with the exact same evidence identity are marked comparable.
Categorical history contains no invented numeric severity delta.
testCommand: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tests/unit'); import test_regional_map_frontend_contract as t; t.test_server_browser_and_numeric_history_contract(); t.test_trend_modal_uses_method_compatible_categorical_history(); t.test_photo_history_uses_the_same_regional_replay_gate(); t.test_face_panel_renders_only_the_sanitized_layer_plan()"
